story: Fashion lookbook 19 s, after the "mẫu thay quần áo" template: 1 she sits holding the new dress on a hanger, delighted; 2 wearing it: catwalk and a pivot to show the side and the paillettes swinging; 3 close: she smooths her hair and adjusts a strap; 4 mirror selfie, the phone covering part of her face. Hard cuts, each shot starts on its storyboard frame. To use your own model photo add "extra_images": ["model.jpg"] and write "Image 3 is the model photo" in the storyboard.
storyboard_prompt: Image 1 is the product photo: use exactly this product, its shape, materials, colours and logos. Create ONE storyboard image made of a 2x2 grid of four equal photo panels, edge to edge, with no borders, no gaps, no text and no numbers. Shot on a 35mm film camera, Kodak Portra 400, visible film grain, slight halation around highlights, natural unretouched colours, a real photograph, not a render. Every panel: the same young Vietnamese woman model in every shot: about 24, long straight dark hair, natural makeup, real skin with visible pores and a few freckles, slim build. a white photo studio with a white paper backdrop that is a little creased and scuffed at the bottom, a grey concrete floor, one large softbox from the left, soft shadows to the right. Vertical 9:16 fashion lookbook frames. Panel 1 (top left): she sits cross-legged on the floor holding a wooden hanger up in front of her with a black mini slip dress with very thin black spaghetti straps and a straight neckline, covered in rows of glossy black sequins and long black teardrop paillettes that swing and shimmer when she moves hanging from it, looking at the dress with a quiet delighted smile, wearing a plain white T-shirt and jeans. Panel 2 (top right): full body: she now wears a black mini slip dress with very thin black spaghetti straps and a straight neckline, covered in rows of glossy black sequins and long black teardrop paillettes that swing and shimmer when she moves with simple black strappy heels, walking toward the camera mid-stride like a catwalk, her eyes past the camera. Panel 3 (bottom left): close-up from the chest up: wearing a black mini slip dress with very thin black spaghetti straps and a straight neckline, covered in rows of glossy black sequins and long black teardrop paillettes that swing and shimmer when she moves, one hand smooths her hair behind her ear, the other adjusts a thin strap on her shoulder; she looks down at the strap. Panel 4 (bottom right): full body: wearing a black mini slip dress with very thin black spaghetti straps and a straight neckline, covered in rows of glossy black sequins and long black teardrop paillettes that swing and shimmer when she moves, she stands in front of a tall mirror leaning on the wall and takes a mirror selfie with her phone, the phone covering part of her face, one hip tilted. The same model, dress and studio in all four panels; the dress keeps the same length and sequin pattern. Candid, unretouched photographs with natural imperfections: real crumbs, dust, fingerprints, uneven light, slight lens vignetting. No extra products, no added text, no watermark.
